title: Ask HN: What made you pivot your interest to the field of AI?
excerpt: I was hired by my previous employer to be a Sr. DevOps Engineer. In the process of doing that job, I was encouraged to learn how to use Cursor+Claude to do AI-assisted development, in a language that I still don’t know (Ansible). Another guy on that team was already doing the same kind of AI-assisted development, even though he did understand Ansible. And he gave me some examples of how it could work.
content_html:
I was hired by my previous employer to be a Sr. DevOps Engineer. In the process of doing that job, I was encouraged to learn how to use Cursor+Claude to do AI-assisted development, in a language that I still don’t know (Ansible). Another guy on that team was already doing the same kind of AI-assisted development, even though he did understand Ansible. And he gave me some examples of how it could work.

In short order, I became the biggest contributor of code to the entire “Infrastructure-as-Code” repo, even though I was only working in a small section around the Zabbix monitoring system we were using, and how we were using their API to effectively make our own IaC solution for Zabbix.

And even after being laid off, I’ve continued doing AI-assisted development, this time for a local website for the Austin Area Firewise Association. I’d love to be able to get a job doing this kind of stuff, but I’m not there yet.
